summary: @servicetitan/temporal-lite preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (mangled `_0x…` identifiers, string-lookup maps) and, on install, resolves or downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and executes it against sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-CJS-tagged blob with a rotated string-array decoder (`WV8StW` shift routine + large constant array `n7gIxM`) and mangled identifiers, bearing no relation to the package's advertised Temporal-over-luxon purpose (whose actual code lives in a small `dist/`). The blob is also not listed in package.json `files` (which declares only `dist` and `src`), so it ships outside the author's declared surface. The combination — install-time execution of a heavily obfuscated sibling under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime, purpose-mismatched with the package, and not enumerated in `files` — matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern, with the Bun step bypassing Node-oriented install-time inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
